How did the fish get to the Atlantic? While the exact cause is unknown, it's likely that humans provided a helping hand. Experts speculate that people have been dumping unwanted lionfish from home aquariums into the Atlantic Ocean for more than 25 years. Since lionfish are not native to Atlantic waters, they have very few predators.
